claim: Cached audit details never refresh, so reopening an entry can show an incomplete response even after the list reloads.
evidence: toggleExpanded returns whenever entryDetails[detailKey] exists, and rendering always prefers that cached object over the current entry. If details are opened before a streamed response finishes, PGAuditReader.UpdateResponse subsequently updates the stored body, status and duration, but collapsing, changing filters and reopening the entry never fetches those updated details.
